_about: Where the installer looks for saved copies, in this order (Jake 11/23 12:40 AM CT, Decision 30 A). The first copy whose bytes match the pinned sha256 wins; every file is hash-checked whichever copy it came from. His home-network drive (a large external disk on his own network, 11/23 12:44 AM) is added later as one more 'folder' entry wherever he wants it in the order. The release repository must be private (Atrium is public); Jake created KULawHawk/adastra-saved-copies (private, checked 11/23 6:30 AM CT). Packages, models and programs (the Windows installers, Decision 174 B) are separate releases ("until_published": true lets Pull skip a release only until its first publish; the flag is removed once it is published) so neither reaches GitHub's 1,000-files-per-release limit. An empty repo is skipped with a row saying so. Read by saved_copies.py.
